### Two-way counter-proof

Support: every value above is fixed by a visible table or clause and a tool return; the replayed sequence succeeds and ends approved at 975.00 due.

Closest alternatives excluded:
- Lateness judged on the returned initial 82afc51b (2026-09-12 -> 8 days, on time -> no fee): excluded by doc_dg_judged_initial_declaration_af20ea98 ("sent back for correction … is never the one judged").
- Counting the portal amendment d4c22887 (would make 3 signed > max 2, or change the charge count): excluded by doc_dg_amendment_free_allowance_9cf5b1d7 ("returned for correction … left out of the count entirely").
- No amendment fee because "that one was charged": the caller's statement concerns 9474bb1c, which does carry its entry; the new amendment is chargeable because the allowance is 0.
- Sailing allotment including the Flammables acceptance on the same voyage (5 + 4 = 9 > 6): excluded — the count is "for the same category".
- Admin fee 0.00 by the per-date rule because of the 60.00 admin fee dated 2026-09-11 on bfc0f29f: excluded — it is another acceptance's account and another date.
- Approve first, amend afterwards: excluded by H5.
- Rejection: excluded — every decision test passes on the amended record.

Wrong answer "do only what the caller asked" (sign the amendment, then approve with 75.00): after the signature the file shows two chargeable amendments against one amendment-fee entry and a short-notice signed initial with no late-fee entry; doc_dg_decision_amendment_charges_84b49151 and doc_dg_decision_late_charge_e0944da6 each say such a file "stays under review, and no decision is entered", and doc_dg_decision_outcome_cd451fbd: "The goods plainly fit, but the file cannot be decided. The status stays under review; fit alone does not produce an approval." So the one-thing answer leaves the governed result in a state the visible principles do not allow. It is excluded by reasoning from the blocked-side principles — and additionally by the outright statements in doc_dg_amended_declaration_review_c84489cb (hops marked read off above).

Blind conclusion: solvable and unique on the visible surface; hops H1–H4 and H6 are readable off doc_dg_amended_declaration_review_c84489cb (to be carried to the implicitness scan).

**RT0-1 — KB-RUNTIME RED (aggregation of the prerequisite chain).**
- Symptom: one visible document lays out, in one place, every problem of this task and the dependency between each pair, so the tree can be followed without deriving any hop.

### Replacement document (read in full)

doc_dg_declarations_account_review_closing_4b191bc4, "Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Signed Declarations, Account Entries and the Closing of a Review": Scope (three record kinds on a file under review; "as standing principles … on any file under review"); "Who writes which record" (declarations signed by the shipper in person, the desk cannot sign, a changed particular stands only through a signed declaration; account entries and the review outcome written by the desk); Principles — "Entries raised by a declaration" (an entry arising from a declaration names a signed declaration on file; an unsigned one gives nothing to name), "Stability of such entries" (an entry raised by one declaration is fixed by it alone; another declaration leaves it as it was), "The file as a whole" (outcome given on the particulars and the account as they stand at deciding), "Closing" (recording the outcome closes the review; what is allowed only on an undecided file is then out of reach); Basis Q&A (desk may not sign for the shipper; a newly signed declaration does not rewrite another declaration's entry).
